DeepSeek bills this model at TWO rates depending on the hour. The tracked figure is the PEAK rate: $0.30 input (cache miss) / $0.006 input (cache hit) / $1.20 output per 1M tokens. Off-peak is exactly half: $0.15 / $0.003 / $0.60. Peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday; every other hour, and all of Saturday and Sunday, is off-peak. Peak is the headline here because DeepSeek defines off-peak as half of peak rather than the other way round, so peak is the list rate, and because a caller who does not schedule around the clock needs the published number to be a ceiling rather than a floor. Halve it for a workload that runs entirely outside those hours. Third-party catalogues that quote this model at $0.15/$0.60 per 1M are printing the OFF-PEAK tier, not a different rate card.
